metadata.title: LES PRINCIPES DE LA THÉORIE NODALE DES COMBINAISONS CHIMIQUES

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface used for "COMBINAISONS CHIMIQUES" is a decorative display face characterized by "inline" detailing (white lines running through the center of the thick strokes), designed to mimic the look of engraved metal or architectural lettering common in late 19th and early 20th-century publishing.
